pyqgis_plugin.name: AutoGIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: Autonomous Geospatial AI Agent, Live MCP Bridge & Spatial Analysis Studio for QGIS with Google Earth Engine (GEE)
pyqgis_plugin.about: AutoGIS is an open-source, standalone Autonomous Geospatial AI Agent, Live MCP Server, and Spatial Analysis Studio for QGIS built in Python (PyQGIS + PyQt5). Connect Cloud AI (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, OpenRouter) or Offline Local AI (Ollama / LM Studio) to Google Earth Engine (GEE), live OpenStreetMap vectors, USGS/NASA hazard feeds, ISRO Bhuvan & ESA WorldCover layers, raster band statistics & zonal statistics, 300 DPI publication layouts, 3D MapLibre web maps, and PyQGIS workflows across 39 autonomous tools.
